svg.title: Wysiwys live devnet payment firewall architecture
svg.desc: A proposal triggers a ten-node CRE workflow. Every node compares three independent RPC providers with two-of-three exact source agreement, followed by CRE consensus. A signed report reaches the Guard through the production Keystone forwarder. Payment requires both human Squads approvals and the exact current, unexpired, unused Guard approval. Live evaluation runs on DON nodes. The TEE path is implemented and simulated only. Ten nodes are observed in recorded live runs, not freshly enumerated.

g.text: What You See Is What You Sign
Exact transaction. Independent review. On-chain enforcement.
PAYMENT = human Squads approvals AND a matching, current, unexpired, unused Guard approval
Choose recipient, token and integer amount.
Guard computes tx_hash; creates PENDING Review.
Funds stay in the Squads vault
Dedupe, retry; SQLite stores activity history.
Signed CRE gateway trigger: identifiers only.
Humans propose and vote; Guard authorizes execution.
The UI reads chain state; previews are descriptive.
Human votes and the Guard review may arrive in either order.
Live DON execution • TypeScript / WASM • private workflow registry
Re-read stored Solana accounts on each node
Each node uses the same three upstream RPC providers:
Finalized reads • shared slot floor • normalized account owners + bytes
Check tx_hash, then decode every instruction in order.
Vault DON secret / authenticated store by hash
LIVE: DON evaluation. TEE path: implemented + simulated only.
117-byte report: verdict + reason + tx_hash + policy_hash + destination_hash + times
Checks hashes, report deadline and expiry.
Live destination still matches; no durable nonce.
Consume Review → executor PDA → Squads CPI
Squads enforces votes + timelock; vault pays.
Any failure rolls back review consumption + payout.
SOL / demo mUSD • executed event → app
Policy: member vote → ≥5 min wait → new policy_hash; old approvals fail.
Members / threshold / timelock: voted guarded_config_execute; sole executor preserved.
Clean payments executed • lookalike rejected • production-forwarder receipts finalized
Checked 7 Oct 2026 • repo e3b8d2c • 10 nodes from recorded live runs; current membership not re-enumerated
No TEE attestation claimed for the live path.
